scope: Packed retained RN SDK arm64 Release executions on iOS Simulator and Android emulator. Both the native acceptance subclass and unmodified generated default startup/layout execute the public retained TauriView component. The exact original WebView moves between parents; its nonpersistent document token and native navigation/UI delegates or clients remain unchanged. Actual frontend geolocation/save and capability denial share Tauri state with direct native calls. Simultaneous second attachment is rejected without stealing the first view. Component unmount/remount, renderer replacement and close restore the original view and retain the document. Native renderer sessions are retired independently of the original Tauri document.
documentIdentityInstrumentation: Only the native acceptance subclasses install an immutable, nonpersistent UUID in the ready original document, once at composition startup. Every observed parent transition reads it without reinjection. The SDK adds no document script and the authored frontend is unchanged.

androidFollyFailure.scope: Original Tauri baseline completed. The first Fabric component descriptor aborted in folly::dynamic destruction during RawPropsParser::prepare. Generated components/OnLoad lacked the standard RN Folly compile options. The final Android CMake imports the pinned upstream folly-flags.cmake and propagates those options to both. The original failure APK, process/crash logs and Maestro screenshot are preserved.

iosHeaderFailure.scope: New Fabric generated includes needed the generated iOS root in the SDK pod header search path. No native acceptance ran in this failed build.

iosScrollFailure.scope: Initial embedded save/event/ACL, competing view and detach passed. Remount attached the original document, but Links received 4 was below the 287-point WebView viewport. Maestro screenshot/hierarchy and acceptance Release binary are preserved. The final scenario scrolls within the WebView before asserting; no production code or assertion was removed.
